info.title: MehrNet BGP API
info.description: Lookup IPv4/IPv6 addresses, CIDR prefixes, IP ranges, ASNs, and active dataset metadata from MehrNet daily BGP, RIR, route, aut-num, and geofeed data. The API performs no upstream lookups at request time.

get.description: Returns the compact BGP/allocation/geofeed lookup object for one IPv4 or IPv6 address. Add details=full to include the matched candidate records used to build the compact response.

Details.name: details
Details.description: Set to full on /v1/ip?query={address} to include matched allocation, route, and geofeed candidate records. Omit it for the compact response.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of paginated route/allocation objects to return.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned as next_cursor by the previous page.

Metadata.description: Response metadata shared by dataset-backed responses.

LookupResponse.description: Compact IP lookup response. details is present only when details=full is requested.

Network.description: Best route/network match selected for the looked-up IP.

Allocation.description: Best allocation selected for the looked-up IP.

Location.description: Geofeed location selected for the looked-up IP when available.

Sources.description: Flags indicating which source classes contributed to the compact response.

LookupDetails.description: Candidate records included only by details=full.
